title: Verifiable User Simulation for Search and Recommendation Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Inspecting execution traces of LLM-based user simulators to identify if simulated behavior (e.g., search query formulation or recommendation selection) varies systematically based on language attributes defined in user personas.

Applying diagnostic discrepancy analysis on matched human-vs-agent execution traces to verify if the LLM simulator's responses vary systematically with the assigned cultural background characteristics.
Auditing structured personas and execution traces to detect systematic variations or discriminatory outcomes in simulated user behavior depending on the specified education level.
